prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, FOUR people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all four are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

FAR LEFT: ONE real adult Maori man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth warm olive-brown skin, a calm gentle gaze, cool ash-grey hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop with a heavy rough bronze a barrel-shaped weight hanging at its end, and four to six layered platinum anklets. Extra long nails in matching polished jade.

Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky.
